fullContent:
Pushpadhanva Rasa 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sara (first part); edition 13; 574 – 576. 
 Introduction 
 Pushpadhanva Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation. This formulation is prepared from the mixture of fruitful herbs and minerals. This medicine is known to treat problems related with sex health. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Parade bhsama (Herbal purified Mercury) 
 Naga bhsama (Lead Calx) 
 Loha bhsama (iron calx) 
 Abhraka bhamsa (Purified and processed Mica) 
 Vanga bhsama (Tin Calx) 
 Dhatura (Datura stramonium) 
 Bhang (Cannabis sativa) 
 Mulethi (Glycyrrhiza glabra) 
 Semal (Bombax ceiba’s bark) 
 Nagavalli (Piper betel’s leaves) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Took the ingredients from number one to five in equal parts and mixed well. 
 Then took another left herbs and made their juice. 
 Now tinctured the above mixture with juices. 
 After the tincture process, took the paste up to 125 mg and made its pills.  
 
 Dose 
 One to two pills, two times a day with milk, clarified butter (ghee), butter or honey. 
 Indications 
 
 Anti-aging 
 Importance 
 Premature ejaculation 
 Low stamina 
 Erectile dysfunction 
 Infertility 
 Chlamydia 
 PCOS 
 Secondary infertility due to genital infections and underdeveloped genital organs. 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoided in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
